description: This file defines the BuzzLikeOnComment entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing a 'like' on a comment in the Buzz social feature. It includes properties for IDs, related comment and employee, and timestamp of the like, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnComment
classes.description: Entity class representing a 'like' on a comment within the OrangeHRM Buzz social feature, with properties for comment, employee, and timestamp, and associated ORM metadata.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the like.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the like.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Associates a BuzzComment with this like.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who liked the comment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this like.

methods.name: getLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the DateTime when the like occurred in UTC.

methods.name: setLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the liked timestamp to the current UTC time.
